bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -f "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 60
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,pathlib,sys
source=pathlib.Path("scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py").read_text()
tree=ast.parse(source)
worker=None
for node in tree.body:
 if isinstance(node,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="EXPECTED_MENU" for t in node.targets):
  worker=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
expected=[
 ["相手募集","募集+Room","告知/予告"],
 ["プロフ作成","クリエーター投稿"],
 ["🔗ボタン作成","検索/フィルター"],
 ["雑談","紹介/招待","操作説明"],
 ["🐞 不具合を報告"],
]
if not isinstance(worker,list):sys.exit(61)
if worker==expected:
 print("USERBOT_STATIC_MENU_CONTRACT=PASS")
 sys.exit(0)
sameRows=[len(x) for x in worker]==[len(x) for x in expected]
print("USERBOT_STATIC_MENU_ROW_SHAPE_MATCH="+str(sameRows))
if sameRows:
 diffs=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(expected) for j,label in enumerate(row) if worker[i][j]!=label]
 print("USERBOT_STATIC_LABEL_DIFFERENCES="+str(len(diffs)))
sys.exit(81)
PY
